sources.citation: Woodward, James. 2018. Endangered sign languages: An introduction. In Campbell & Rehg (eds.), The Oxford Handbook of Endangered Languages, 168-202. Oxford: OUP.

sources.note: The only published work Glottolog ties to the Mandalay variety (p. 200); its abstract says it treats sign language phonology and formational parameters for ten Southeast Asian sign languages including Yangon and Mandalay MSL. It would settle whether anything phonological is said about the variety at all (it will not contain a word-stress rule).

sources.citation: Watkins, Justin. 2010. Sign language in Burma: two Burmese finger spelling systems used in Yangon. Burma Studies Conference, Marseille, 6-9 July 2010.

sources.note: Only linguist-authored description of any formational aspect of Myanmar signing (fingerspelling); Yangon only, likely silent on Mandalay and on prosody.
